clue.text: Warlike master of the Latin epigram

definitions.meaning: warlike means military, belligerent
the Roman poet Marcus Valerius Martialis, famed for his epigrams

explanation.surface: A belligerent Roman poet known for sharp short verses.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the adjective for things military; the other is the name of the first-century Roman epigrammatist.

clue.text: Damage on the way in at seaside

parts.note: to damage is to mar
a gate is a way in

explanation.surface: Damage done to an entrance at a beach resort.
explanation.walkthrough: MARGATE is a traditional English seaside resort in Kent.
explanation.definitionFit: The Kent town is a classic British holiday resort on the coast.

clue.text: Mussolini in communist surroundings brought down to size

indicators.note: communist surroundings means the word for communist wraps round Mussolini's title

parts.note: a communist is a red
Mussolini was known as Il Duce, the leader

explanation.surface: The Italian dictator, hemmed in by communists, is cut down to size.
explanation.walkthrough: Benito Mussolini styled himself Il Duce, the leader; 'surroundings' tells you the red word wraps round that title.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reduced has been made smaller, cut down.

clue.text: Reform maims Islamic leaders

indicators.note: reform means rebuild the letters of the next word into a new shape

explanation.surface: A call for reform among Islamic clerics, or a maiming.
explanation.definitionFit: Imams are prayer leaders in mosques.

clue.text: Subsequently joins forces sideways

parts.note: subsequently means later
to ally is to join forces

explanation.surface: Later on, an alliance is formed by moving sideways.
explanation.definitionFit: Lateral movement is movement to the side.

clue.text: Pack in tightly by agreement

definitions.meaning: to compress or press together firmly
a pact or treaty

explanation.surface: Things packed tightly according to a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means press firmly together; as a noun it is a formal pact between parties.

clue.text: Desert ship in which it came loose

indicators.note: in shows the answer sits within the following words

explanation.surface: A ship of the desert whose load came loose.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'it CAME Loose'; 'which it' is linking.
explanation.definitionFit: The camel is traditionally called the ship of the desert.

clue.text: Counterfeit sovereign for copying

parts.note: to counterfeit is to mimic
a king is a sovereign

explanation.surface: A forged gold coin passed off as a copy.
explanation.definitionFit: Mimicking is imitating, doing an impression.

clue.text: Yearn after later life, having existed for many years

indicators.note: after places the word for yearn behind the word for later life

parts.note: later life is old age
to yearn is to long

explanation.surface: Yearning in old age for something that has lasted for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Agelong describes something lasting an age, very long-standing.

clue.text: Dance at the teddy bears picnic? That's where they were bought

parts.note: teddy bears are toys
a hop is an informal dance

explanation.surface: The teddy bears' picnic: where the bears dance, and where they came from.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as TOY'S HOP, a dance of the toys at their picnic.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop selling playthings is where teddies are purchased.

clue.text: Prepare another plan as a life-saver for the Russian sailor?

parts.note: red is a traditional label for the Soviet Russian
a raft can save life at sea

explanation.surface: A Russian sailor's inflatable life-saver.
explanation.definitionFit: To draft again is to write out a second version of a plan.

clue.text: Mother gets round a hesitant sound in dumb show

indicators.note: gets round means the word for mother encloses the hesitant sound

parts.note: mummy is a word for mother
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Mother hesitates during a game of charades.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets round' signals a container: the hesitant noise sits inside the word for mother. Mummers were traditional English folk players performing in masks.
explanation.definitionFit: Mummery is play-acting in mime, as by traditional masked mummers.

clue.text: Lancaster designed according to our forefathers

indicators.note: designed means the letters of the city name are laid out anew

explanation.surface: The Lancaster, a famous bomber, built to an old family pattern.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancestral means inherited from or relating to forebears.

clue.text: Suitable material for the clergy

definitions.meaning: fabric, a woven textile
an idiom for the clerical profession

explanation.surface: Fabric fit for vicars' vestments.
explanation.definitionFit: It is woven fabric, and 'the cloth' is a set phrase for priests collectively.

clue.text: Final alternatives for the pitch of a Biblical witch

definitions.text: the pitch of a Biblical witch

parts.note: the final part is the end
or introduces alternatives

explanation.surface: A last choice of where a sorceress from scripture sets up.
explanation.walkthrough: In 1 Samuel, Saul consults the witch of Endor; 'pitch' means her place.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament witch lived at this village, so it was her location.

clue.text: Set right and clad again

definitions.meaning: remedied a wrong
put clothes on once more

explanation.surface: Wrongs corrected and someone dressed a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense means remedied or rectified; the other reads as dressed once more.

clue.text: By raising the gaze things should be improving

definitions.meaning: lifting the eyes upward
a phrase for prospects getting better

explanation.surface: An optimist lifting their eyes in hope.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally it is directing the eyes upward; idiomatically it means getting better.

clue.text: Outworn religious trappings that are hard to shake off

definitions.meaning: worn-out robes of monks or nuns

definitions.text: that are hard to shake off
definitions.meaning: the saying that ingrained routines die hard

explanation.surface: Old robes of a religious order that cling on.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally aged nuns' garments; figuratively ingrained routines, as in the proverb that they die hard.

clue.text: Mythical nymph with a deadly bite

definitions.meaning: a tree nymph of Greek myth
the king cobra, a venomous snake

explanation.surface: A dangerous nymph of legend.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth it is a wood nymph living in a tree; it is also another name for the king cobra.

clue.text: Writer with a wild look

definitions.meaning: H. Rider ..., author of King Solomon's Mines
gaunt and wild-eyed

explanation.surface: An author with a crazed expression.
explanation.definitionFit: The Victorian novelist shares the name of the adjective for gaunt and careworn.

clue.text: It's one in the eye for confused cool men

indicators.note: confused means the letters of the two words are mixed up

explanation.surface: A muddled group of hip men takes a blow to the eye.
explanation.definitionFit: A single eyeglass is worn in one eye socket.

clue.text: Port and cake from N. Italy

definitions.meaning: the Ligurian harbour city
a rich fruit cake named after that city

explanation.surface: A northern Italian harbour and its cake.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a major Italian seaport and also gives its name to a rich fruit cake.

clue.text: Lucerne the paragon

definitions.meaning: lucerne is a fodder plant, alfalfa or medick
something without equal

explanation.surface: Lucerne as the perfect Swiss city.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an old name for a kind of medick related to alfalfa, and an archaic word for something unrivalled.

clue.text: A comparatively good assistant

parts.note: better is the comparative of good

explanation.surface: A helper who is a bit better than most.
explanation.definitionFit: An abettor is someone who helps, usually in wrongdoing.

clue.text: Bottled spirit from the Arabian Nights

definitions.text: Bottled spirit from the Arabian Nights

parts.words: Bottled spirit from the Arabian Nights
parts.note: spirit reads as a drink but is a supernatural being shut in a lamp or bottle in the tales

explanation.surface: A bottle of liquor out of the old Arabian tales.
explanation.definitionFit: A jinn is a magical being, famously confined in a lamp or bottle in the tales.

clue.text: Make changes behind cook's fireplace

parts.note: the rear is the behind
a range is a cooking stove set in a hearth

explanation.surface: Renovating the kitchen hearth at the back.
explanation.definitionFit: To order differently is to alter the arrangement.

clue.text: Transgress again? It's sticky business

definitions.meaning: re plus sin, to sin once more
a gummy substance from trees

explanation.surface: Sinning a second time is a sticky situation.
explanation.definitionFit: Split as RE-SIN it is sinning anew; whole, it is the gummy sap that oozes from pines.

clue.text: Church incumbent curtailed the right page.

indicators.note: curtailed means the last letter is cut off the word for the church incumbent

parts.note: a rector holds a parish living

explanation.surface: A parish priest cut short the correct page.
explanation.definitionFit: The right-hand page of an open book is called the recto.

clue.text: Charges 26 perhaps

parts.note: 26 refers to the entry for where justice is done, so this is what prosecutors do there

explanation.surface: Charges laid at a hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 26 refers to 26-across, IN COURT: making charges is what happens in court.
explanation.definitionFit: To accuse is to charge someone formally with an offence.

clue.text: Where justice is served and service is adjusted

definitions.meaning: the setting of a legal trial
in tennis a serve is judged good if it lands within the lines

explanation.surface: Justice and tennis serves both judged in the same place.
explanation.definitionFit: Trials take place before a judge in a law chamber, and a tennis serve counts only if it lands within the playing area.

clue.text: East Germany's Chinatown

parts.note: the city in former East Germany famed for its porcelain, so a town of china

explanation.surface: A Chinese quarter in an East German city.
explanation.walkthrough: Dresden china is fine porcelain from the Meissen works near the city, which lay in East Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: The Saxon city gave its name to a famous porcelain, making it a town of china.

clue.text: Order to stifle 1,000 others in disorder

indicators.note: in places the thousand inside the jumbled letters
disorder means the letters of others are scrambled

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: An order to suppress a thousand people in a riot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disorder' rearranges OTHERS to SOTHER; 'in' puts M inside it after S.
explanation.definitionFit: To stifle is to suffocate or suppress.
